note: lettre de prorogation (28 octobre 2017) du crédit du 30 juin 2016 : comptes audités 2017 attendus au 15 janvier 2018 au lieu du 28 octobre 2017
quote: The Extension Letter extends the date by which delivery of the Company's audited Consolidated and consolidating financial statements for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2017 ("FYE 2017 Financial Statements") and the FYE 2017 Compliance Certificate (as defined in the Extension Letter) is required from no later than October 28, 2017 to January 15, 2018 (the "Extended Delivery Date"), subject to the requirements set forth in the Extension Letter.
